metadata.rust_dispatch: runtime Pulp Arch::new; worker records actual specialization
metadata.rust_call_boundary: direct ShtPlan calls on a process-global Rayon pool; no per-call ThreadPool::install wrapper
metadata.ducc_dispatch: fixed x86-64-v3 C++ build (AVX2/FMA, four f64 lanes)
metadata.affinity_policy: q1: one allowed physical core; q8: eight allowed physical cores

protocol.interleaving: Rust then DUCC for even process-pair indexes; DUCC then Rust for odd indexes
protocol.thread_control: Rust process-global Rayon pool configured before plan creation; DUCC DUCC0_NUM_THREADS; both workers report active pool capacity
protocol.input_layout: identical compact m-major coefficient body; DUCC mstart adds a leading offset and maps without timed conversion
protocol.fixture_generation: deterministic PCG64 seed derived from lmax, mmax, and nphi; SHA-256 of each alm/map fixture is recorded per case
protocol.output_buffers: reused across calls; transform outputs read and compared outside timed intervals
protocol.timed_region: direct native ShtPlan transform calls with a process-global Rayon pool reused; pool/workspace setup and first call reported separately
protocol.rust_call_boundary: no per-call ThreadPool::install wrapper; RAYON_NUM_THREADS is set before process startup
protocol.short_operation_calibration: up to three untimed repeated-call batches; adjust repetitions until 20-100 ms, then collect 10 measured batches
protocol.long_transform_rule: operations whose warmup exceeds 100 ms are timed individually (five per process invocation)
protocol.output_reset_check: after timing, exact comparison of first-call output and last repeated-call output
